name: multi_buy_at_price_leaves_units_for_bogo
description: THE CORE-001 DELIBERATE CHANGE. A multi_buy (id 1, '3 for 1.000') whose only candidate set is UNDER the bundle price (3 x 0.300 = 0.900) yields no discount. pos_machine consumed the 3 units before breaking, so the later BOGO (id 2) found nothing and the customer overcharged; the core adopts pos_handheld's break-without-consume, so the BOGO applies: buy one 0.300 unit, get one free (0.300 off). Hand-computed: raw 900; offers = bogo only, line 0 amount 300; discount 300; subtotal 600; no tax; grand 600.
